name: ntfy-mcp-server
description: Send, manage, and replay ntfy push notifications via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Send, manage, and replay ntfy push notifications via MCP.
interface.longDescription: ntfy-mcp-server drives ntfy push notifications from an agent. ntfy_publish_message sends or updates a notification on a topic (topics are created on first publish; a sequence_id turns a later call into an in-place update); ntfy_manage_message clears or deletes a previously-sent notification by sequence_id; ntfy_fetch_messages polls cached messages from one or more topics with filters — confirm delivery, replay missed alerts, or audit topic activity; ntfy_search_emoji_tags resolves emoji short codes for the tags field. Works against ntfy.sh or any self-hosted ntfy instance.
